scope: Female LH, strictly over 16 and under 18 years: display the actual current measurement without a population reference.
ownerDecision: Accepted the concrete result-only proposal on 2026-10-20: no default Zhao median, no new questionnaire, retain existing laboratory assessment and patient data reuse.
clinicalImpact: Presentation eligibility changes for a missing result point; no new reference interval, threshold, diagnosis, percentile, SDS or source median is introduced.

sourceReview.purpose: Compare actual published central values and their population/phase/method limitations before deciding whether one can become the default for this source gap.

sources.access: Full final article and supplement reviewed; S2 and group counts cross-checked.
sources.location: Supplemental Table S2; Table 1 group counts; main Table 4 author-merged group.
sources.population: Chinese reference cohort recruited in Wuhan in 2022–2023; female LH subgroup >15–18 years, N=112.
sources.reportedStatistic: Group median 7.14 mIU/mL (numerically 7.14 IU/L); not a continuous age model or a median of an isolated 16–18 subgroup.
limitations: Cycle phase and oral contraception were not separately standardized/stratified; a generic medication exclusion does not establish an ovulatory untreated cycle for every participant.
Exact operational age assignment was not fully specified. An application interval (16,18) would be a conservative policy, not a recovered author definition.
Screening for normal laboratory findings and outlier handling limit transferability; the precise extent of hormone-based prescreening is unclear.
Main Table 4 combines >12–19 years, N=244, with median 6.79; this is a different group, not a discrepancy that can be averaged with S2.

sources.citation: Assens et al. 2020, Menstrual Pattern, Reproductive Hormones, and Transabdominal 3D Ultrasound in 317 Adolescent Girls
sources.access: Publisher full HTML methods/results and direct primary Table 2 reviewed; table values independently checked. No claim of a downloaded full PDF.
sources.location: Methods and Table 2 with its footnotes.
sources.population: Danish Copenhagen Mother-Child Cohort follow-up, ages 12–18, median age 16.1. 317 participated; LH N differs by analysis group.
sources.reportedStatistic: Table 2 medians in U/L: regular cycles, LH N=122, median 3.0; all measured postmenarchal participants without hormonal contraception, LH N=223, median 3.3.
limitations: The clinical regular-cycle group has 130 participants but only 122 LH measurements. Do not use 130 as the LH N.
Sampling was intended for cycle days 2–5, but only 131 participants were sampled then; 175 on days 1–7. Do not call the entire hormone analysis uniformly early-follicular.
Regular cycles do not confirm ovulation or absence of PCOS in every participant.
No separate numerical median restricted to ages 16–18 was reported in this table.
Table 2 dispersion values are P10/P90, not P2.5/P97.5 reference intervals.

sources.access: Full primary article pages 395–401 reviewed; Table 4 visually cross-checked.
sources.method: Abbott IMx MEIA, older WHO 68/40 calibration
limitations: Samples were collected 08–10; sexually mature girls within the first 10 days of the follicular phase.
No isolated numerical median for the 16–18-year stratum was published; the reported median combines ages 14–18.
Separate oral-contraception exclusion was not verified; do not claim it.
The older method/calibration and restricted sampling context prevent direct substitution or pooling with Zhao.

sourceReview.conclusion: The differing real group medians do not establish an error in Zhao, an effect of geography alone or a universal median. Do not average them, treat them as a 3–7 normal range, harmonize assays, or infer a continuous age reference. None is imported as the default in this change.

technicalContract.data: Keep patientPointData and all 82 source profiles unchanged. Store the separately versioned display policy in root runtime.resultOnlyPolicies.
technicalContract.evaluation: Existing evaluate/selectProfile remain unchanged. evaluateResultOnly can qualify only after ordinary selection reports unsupported-age, never after a present profile's method/specimen/context rejection. Its result-only status has no profile, referenceValue or population statistic.
technicalContract.age: All possible chronological ages must fit (16,18). Exact 16 retains Madsen; an interval starting at 16 does not qualify. An upper-exclusive endpoint of 18 can qualify; exact 18 or an upper-inclusive endpoint of 18 cannot. No midpoint selection or boundary shifts.
technicalContract.plot: Ordinary female full-life view only; retain the fixed 0–70 IU/L log1p axis, existing educational curves and other hormone scales. No median marker, connecting line or new reference curve. Above-axis values use an arrow with the real number.
technicalContract.otherViews: Puberty remains 6–16 and directs an eligible older patient to full life for the result only. No new concentration point in relative minipuberty, cycle inset or sex comparison.
technicalContract.measurement: Finite nonnegative exact numeric result in an existing supported unit. Preserve zero. Never turn a censoring operator, LOD/LOQ or illustrative curve value into an exact measurement.
technicalContract.context: Preserve current identity/source readiness and existing positive contraindication, pregnancy/menopause, therapy/GnRHa and stimulation guards. Known non-serum specimen is excluded by the conservative policy. Unknown context stays unknown; no new mandatory controls.
technicalContract.method: Known assay identity does not need to match any publication for a result-only point, because there is no population comparison. This cannot bypass incompatibility of an existing reference and does not establish assay harmonization.
technicalContract.history: Do not alter laboratory assessment or historical snapshots. Educational reference snapshots remain AMH-only; no empty LH reference snapshot is introduced.

validationStatus: Production-function unit regressions, desktop/mobile UI and real PWA lifecycle/offline checks belong to this PR. Their actual results and all GitHub checks for the final SHA are reported by the parent implementation task/PR; this evidence file does not assert a pass or clinical validation.
